intro: Someone has been following you for three waves now.$They finally step out of the shadows — and they're wearing a uniform you'd normally battle on sight.
speaker: Faction Admin
introDialogue: Relax. If this were an ambush, you'd already be losing.$The boss has been reading your file. Ball theft. Evading justice. A GYM LEADER complaint file three centimeters thick.$Frankly? We're impressed. {{factionName}} doesn't recruit often, and never twice.$Run a few jobs for us. Prove the file isn't exaggerated.$And at the end of the road, there's something waiting that no Poké Mart sells.$Something… legendary. In the fully literal sense.$In or out. The offer expires when I stop talking.
title: An Offer From {{factionName}}
description: Your criminal reputation has attracted {{factionName}}. Join, and a three-mission chain opens — ending with a chance to capture their pivotal legendary Pokémon (a real, registered capture). Refuse, and they will never ask again.

1.label: Join the Family
1.tooltip:
(+) Opens the 3-stage mission chain
(+) The chain ends at a catchable legendary
(-) Missions are hard, and declining them counts against you
1.selected: Smart. The boss said you would be.$First job comes soon. We'll find you — we always find you.$Don't die before then. Paperwork's a nightmare.

2.label: Decline the Underworld
2.tooltip:
(+) Keep what's left of your conscience
(-) The faction never asks twice
2.selected: …Huh. The file DID say 'unpredictable'.$Enjoy the gym leaders and the police, hero. They won't chase you any softer for this.$We won't meet again.

outro: They vanish into the tall grass with unsettling practice.$Somewhere, you suspect, a file about you just got thicker.
